tasks.short: Monitor mine production rates to assess operational effectiveness.

steps.what: Monitor mine production rates to assess operational effectiveness.

tasks.design: The mining engineer watches production rates on the {OPS_SYSTEM} and judges operational effectiveness in that same watch. Those rates are already on the screen as existing runtime. No second entry of the rates is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A wrong call on whether the mine is effective is hard to undo once the shift acts on it, and the rates alone do not say why.
tasks.enabler_now: Class machines and a dashboard score are priors. The digest's code, simulation, site-layout, plan-check, requirements, and validation tools cover other engineer tasks. They do not watch this mine's production rates or judge operational effectiveness, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Whether these rates mean the operation is effective has to be judged on this shift.
tasks.human_edge: Standing behind the call that the mine is or is not operating effectively.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The mining engineer still watches the rates and judges operational effectiveness.

reach.learn: Learn how a petroleum engineer reads field rates against the plan for that field.

evidence.claim: Watching mine production rates and judging operational effectiveness is the mining engineer's own look at figures that already sit on the operations screen. Code, simulation, site-layout, and validation tools for other engineer tasks do not do that watch.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the mining engineer watches production rates on the {OPS_SYSTEM} and judges effectiveness in that watch. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. The rates are existing runtime. If the screen is down, the engineer asks the shift and still judges. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this mine asks the engineer to retype the same rates into a second record after watching them. That retype is not in this statement.
research_questions: Does this engineer retype the same production rates into a second record after watching them on the {OPS_SYSTEM}?

already_counted.description: Watching the rates and judging operational effectiveness remain in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still watches the rates and judges effectiveness on the same screen. No second entry goes away. A conservative case is a full shift of rate-watching, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise, train, and evaluate technicians, technologists, survey personnel, engineers, scientists or other mine personnel.

steps.what: Supervise, train, and evaluate technicians, technologists, survey personnel, engineers, scientists or other mine personnel.

tasks.design: The mining engineer supervises, trains, and evaluates mine personnel in person. No second entry of a training note or an evaluation is removed. The crew is still met and judged by the engineer.
tasks.previous_blocker: Training and evaluation depend on watching the person do the work, and a wrong evaluation affects that person's job.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human and a workflow-automation score are priors. The digest's code, simulation, site-layout, plan-check, requirements, and validation tools cover other engineer tasks. They do not supervise, train, or evaluate mine personnel, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Whether this person is ready, and how to train them, has to be judged in person.
tasks.human_edge: Standing with the crew to train them and to evaluate their work.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The mining engineer still supervises, trains, and evaluates mine personnel in person.

reach.task: Train a survey crew on site procedure
reach.learn: Learn the field checks a survey crew is trained to perform.

evidence.claim: Supervising, training, and evaluating mine personnel is in-person work by the mining engineer. Code, simulation, and validation tools for other engineer tasks do not train or judge that crew.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the mining engineer supervises, trains, and evaluates mine personnel in person. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a procedure note is missing, the engineer still trains from the work itself. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this mine asks the engineer to retype an evaluation into a second personnel record after judging the person. That retype is not in this statement.
research_questions: Does this engineer retype an evaluation into a second personnel record after judging the person in person?

already_counted.description: Supervising, training, and evaluating mine personnel remain in this step.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still supervises, trains, and evaluates the crew in person. No second entry goes away. A conservative case is a crew that must be trained on site, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.short: Examine maps and mines, then determine deposit profitability.

steps.what: Examine deposits or mines on the ground.
For mineral, oil, and gas deposits, determine location, size, accessibility, contents, value, and potential profitability.

tasks.design: The mining engineer examines maps and drilling locations, examines the deposit or the mine on the ground, and then determines location, access, contents, value, and potential profitability. No map is re-keyed and no second entry of that call is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Profitability depends on what is in the ground, and a wrong call on value is hard to undo once development starts.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human and a judgement-step score are priors. The digest's code, simulation, site-layout, plan-check, requirements, and validation tools cover other engineer tasks. They do not examine this deposit or determine its profitability, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: Location, access, contents, value, and potential profitability have to be judged for this deposit.
tasks.human_edge: Standing behind the call on what the deposit is worth.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The mining engineer still examines the maps and the ground and still makes the profitability call.

reach.task: Examine maps and ground for a deposit
reach.learn: Learn how a geodetic surveyor reads location and access on the ground.

evidence.claim: Examining maps, drilling locations, and the mine, then judging value and potential profitability, is the mining engineer's own reading of this deposit. Site-layout and plan-check tools for other engineer tasks do not make that call.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the mining engineer examines maps and drilling locations, examines the deposit or the mine on the ground, and determines the profitability call. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a map is missing, the engineer gets it from the survey office and still examines the ground. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this mine asks the engineer to retype the profitability call into a second record after making it. That retype is not in this statement.
research_questions: Does this engineer retype the profitability call into a second record after making it?

already_counted.description: Examining the maps, examining the ground, and making the profitability call remain in these steps.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still examines the maps and the ground and still makes the profitability call. No second entry goes away. A conservative case is a deposit that has to be examined on the ground, so the low stays at zero.

tasks.short: Design, implement, and monitor the development of mines, facilities, systems, or equipment.

steps.what: Design mines, facilities, systems, or equipment.
On site, implement and monitor the development.

tasks.design: The mining engineer writes the design of the mine, facility, system, or equipment, then implements and monitors the development on site. A model does not take over the design. No second entry of the design is removed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A mine design that is wrong is hard to undo once development is underway, and the engineer stays responsible for it.
tasks.enabler_now: Class human and a dashboard score are priors. The digest's note that advice, design, and research stay manual is about other tasks in this group. Its tools do not design this mine or direct its development, so this task stays as it is.
tasks.still_hard: The development has to be designed for this ground and then directed on site.
tasks.human_edge: Standing behind the design and the direction of the development.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes. The mining engineer still writes the design and still directs the development on site.

reach.task: Design the development of a mine facility
reach.learn: Learn the environmental limits a mine facility design has to meet.

evidence.claim: Designing a mine and directing its development on site stay with the mining engineer. The group's note that design stays manual covers other engineer tasks and does not hand this design to a model.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: the mining engineer writes the design and then implements and monitors the development on site. No structured feed is added, so there is no new field and no producer. If a drawing is missing, the engineer still works from the ground and their own notes. Manual fallback is that the person continues as now.
Incremental upkeep is zero. No template, mapping, or list is added.
unknowns: Whether this mine asks the engineer to retype the design into a second system after writing it. That retype is not in this statement.
research_questions: Does this engineer retype the design into a second system after writing it?

already_counted.description: Writing the design and directing the development on site remain in these steps.

incremental.description: No template, mapping, or list is kept. Upkeep hours are zero.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The engineer still writes the design and still directs the development on site. No second entry goes away. A conservative case is a mine development directed in person by the engineer, so the low stays at zero.
